job.title: Senior Quantity Surveyor
job.description:
Senior Quantity Surveyor | Data Centre Construction

V7 Recruitment are working with a leading construction and data centre delivery specialist to recruit an experienced Senior Quantity Surveyor to join their project delivery team in Vaasa, Finland and Kristiansand, Norway.
This is an excellent opportunity to take a senior commercial role on a large-scale, technically complex data centre project. You will take ownership of the commercial and contractual management of the project, working closely with the Contracts Manager, Project Manager and wider delivery team.

What's On Offer
  • Competitive salary €100,000 - €125,000
  • 3 weeks on / 1 week off rotation
  • Full relocation support available
  • Flights and shared accommodation provided
  • Daily allowance of approximately €50–€60
  • Shared car hire
  • Pension and standard benefits
  • Major, high-profile construction projects
  • Strong career development opportunities
The Role
  • Take ownership of the commercial strategy and financial performance of the project.
  • Lead procurement, subcontractor selection, negotiations and final accounts.
  • Manage project costs, valuations, forecasting and cashflow.
  • Oversee variations, change control, claims and commercial entitlement.
  • Manage commercial risks and opportunities throughout the project lifecycle.
  • Ensure contractual compliance and protect the company’s commercial position.
  • Provide accurate commercial reporting to senior management.
  • Support and mentor junior Quantity Surveyors and commercial staff.
  • Build strong relationships with clients, consultants and subcontractors.
What We're Looking For
  • Degree qualified in Quantity Surveying or a related discipline.
  • Significant experience as a Quantity Surveyor on large-scale construction projects.
  • Strong experience across cost management, procurement, contracts and change control.
  • Experience delivering complex design and build projects and high-value contracts.
  • Strong knowledge of construction contracts, ideally including NEC and JCT.
  • Data centre, mission-critical or other technically complex project experience would be highly advantageous.
  • Strong commercial awareness, negotiation and stakeholder management skills.
  • Proven experience supporting and developing junior commercial staff.
  • Chartered membership of RICS, CIOB or equivalent would be advantageous.
V7 Recruitment is an equal opportunities employer. All applications are considered based on merit and suitability for the role.


V7 Recruitment is an equal opportunities employer and does not discriminate on the grounds of age, disability, gender, gender reassignment, marriage or civil partnership, pregnancy or maternity, race, religion or belief, sex, or sexual orientation. job.title: Lead Planner
job.description:
Project Planner | Data Centre Construction

V7 Recruitment are working with a leading construction and data centre delivery specialist to recruit an experienced Project Planner to join their growing project delivery team in Copenhagen, Denmark

This is an excellent opportunity for a Planner with construction experience to work on large-scale, technically complex data centre projects. You will play a key role in developing, managing and monitoring project programmes across design, procurement, construction, commissioning and handover.

What's On Offer
  • Competitive salary €75,000 - €100,000
  • 3 weeks on / 1 week off rotation
  • Full relocation support available
  • Flights and shared accommodation provided
  • Daily allowance of approximately €50–€60
  • Shared car hire
  • Pension and standard benefits
  • Major, high-profile construction projects
  • Strong career development opportunities

  • Develop and manage baseline and target construction programmes using Primavera P6 and/or Asta Powerproject.

job.title: Senior Commercial Manager
job.description:
Senior Commercial Manager | Data Centre Construction

V7 Recruitment are working with a leading construction and data centre delivery specialist to recruit experienced Senior Commercial Managers and Senior Quantity Surveyors to join their growing project delivery teams in Vaasa, Finland and Kristiansand, Norway.

This is an excellent opportunity for a commercially driven professional to take a senior role on a large-scale, technically complex construction project in Europe. You will be responsible for the commercial delivery of the project, providing leadership across cost and value management, contract administration, financial reporting, risk and change control.

You’ll be joining a well-established, family-owned construction business with a global reach and a strong track record of delivering some of Europe’s most significant construction projects.

What's On Offer
  • Salary of €100,000–€130,000
  • 3 weeks on / 1 week off rotational model.
  • Full relocation support available for candidates who prefer to relocate permanently.
  • Flights covered.
  • Shared accommodation provided.
  • Daily allowance of approximately €50–€60 per day.
  • Shared car hire provided.
  • Pension and standard benefits package.
  • Opportunity to work on major, high-profile construction projects.
  • Strong opportunities for career development and progression.
  • Collaborative environment with experienced project and commercial teams.
The Role
  • Leading cost and value management across the project.
  • Ensuring robust commercial systems, procedures and controls are maintained.
  • Overseeing financial reporting, forecasting and cashflow management.
  • Negotiating contract terms, bonds, warranties and guarantees with clients and key stakeholders.
  • Managing change control, variations and entitlement recovery.
  • Leading commercial risk and opportunity management alongside the project operations team.
  • Providing commercial guidance and support to the wider project delivery team.
  • Leading, mentoring and developing the commercial team.
  • Overseeing cost plans and commercial reporting.
  • Analysing project costs to support strategic decision-making.
  • Ensuring commercial governance and company standards are maintained.
  • Preparing long-term cashflow forecasts and commercial reports.
  • Developing commercial controls to monitor project financial performance.
  • Building strong relationships with clients, consultants and subcontractors.
  • Advising on contractual risk, subcontract agreements and commercial compliance.
  • Supporting wider business planning and representing the business within relevant industry networks.
What We're Looking For
  • Degree qualified in Quantity Surveying, Commercial Management, Construction Management or a related discipline.
  • Significant experience in a senior commercial or quantity surveying position within construction.
  • Strong experience across cost management, contract administration, change control and commercial reporting.
  • Experience managing commercial risk, variations and contractual entitlement.
  • Strong understanding of construction contracts and subcontract management.
  • Experience working on large-scale, complex construction projects.
  • Data centre, mission-critical or other technically complex project experience would be highly advantageous.
  • Proven leadership experience, including managing and developing commercial teams.
  • Strong financial, analytical and negotiation skills.
  • Excellent communication skills with the ability to build effective relationships with clients, subcontractors and senior stakeholders.
Rotational / Relocation ModelThe role offers a 3 weeks on / 1 week off rotation, providing an attractive option for people who want to work internationally while maintaining regular time at home.

Alternatively, full relocation support is available for candidates who would prefer to relocate permanently. Partners are welcome to relocate, with shared accommodation and car hire arrangements available.

job.title: MEP Preconstruction Manager
job.description:
Our client are a leading construction company who focus on large scale commercial and residential projects across the North West. We are recruiting for a MEP Preconstruction Manager to join their team focusing on projects during the preconstruction stage. The role provides technical leadership throughout the pre-construction phase, from bid through to project award, ensuring building services designs are fully coordinated, compliant, commercially viable, buildable and aligned with programme objectives.

In return they are offering:
  • Competitive salary
  • Car Allowance
  • Electric car vehicle scheme 
  • Bonus scheme
  • Enhanced holidays + bank holidays
  • Enhanced pension contribution
  • Healthcare
  • Life Assurance

Ideal Candidate
  • Mechanically biased.
  • Prior experience working on projects during the preconstruction stage. 
  • 10+ years’ Building Services experience would be beneficial.
  • Main Contractor or Tier 1 MEP Contractor background.
  • Experience on £30m+ complex projects.
  • Strong Design & Build experience.
  • Experienced in consultant/subcontractor design management.
  • Strong BIM / ISO 19650 knowledge.
  • Degree/HNC/HND in MEP, Mechanical or Electrical Engineering.
  • SMSTS, CSCS and ideally Chartered/working towards Chartership.
  • Strong communicator, technically confident, commercially aware and solutions-focused.

Duties include
  • Lead MEP design management from tender through contract award.
  • Act as the key interface between MEP, consultants, clients, subcontractors and construction teams.
  • Review tender information and develop Contractor’s Proposals, design strategies and programmes.
  • Ensure MEP designs are coordinated, compliant, buildable and commercially viable.
  • Manage consultants and specialist subcontractors, including design development and technical deliverables.
  • Lead BIM, multidisciplinary coordination, design reviews and technical workshops.
  • Manage integration of MEP and specialist/life-safety systems.
  • Identify and mitigate technical, design and commercial risks.
  • Support estimating, procurement, value engineering and subcontractor negotiations.
  • Ensure compliance with Building Regulations, British Standards, CIBSE, BSRIA, CDM and client requirements.
  • Drive buildability, MMC, standardisation, sustainability and design efficiency.
  • Lead design handover to the construction team, ensuring risks, assumptions and requirements are clearly communicated.
  • Support builders’ work coordination and associated MEP requirements.



V7 Recruitment is an equal opportunities employer and does not discriminate on the grounds of age, disability, gender, gender reassignment, marriage or civil partnership, pregnancy or maternity, race, religion or belief, sex, or sexual orientation. All applications will be considered solely on merit and suitability for the role.

job.title: Senior Project Planner
job.description:
Senior Project Planner | Data Centre Construction | Fly in - Fly Out 

Are you a Project Planner based in Germany looking for an opportunity to work on major data centre projects in one of Europe’s fastest-growing markets?

I’m currently recruiting for a Senior Project Planner and Project Planners to join a leading data centre delivery specialist in Helsinki.

We’re keen to speak with Planners with experience in large-scale construction, infrastructure, mission-critical or high-tech projects, with strong Primavera P6 and/or Asta Powerproject experience.

 
What's On Offer
  • Opportunity to work on major, high-profile data centre projects.
  • Salary upto €115,000 DOE
  • Accommodation (or accommodation allowance) provided.
  • Weekly allowance provided.
  • 3 or 5 Week rotation travel expenses covered to and from the UK.
  • Multiple shift patterns available.
  • Clear opportunities for career development and progression.
  • Collaborative and supportive project environment.
 
The Role
  • Developing, maintaining and reviewing detailed master construction programmes.
  • Producing project controls procedures, progress reviews and reports for senior stakeholders.
  • Monitoring project progress, identifying risks, delays and programme variances.
  • Supporting proactive problem-solving and implementing corrective actions where required.
  • Managing programme resource requirements across pre-construction, construction and commissioning phases.
  • Creating and maintaining progress reporting tools to track key milestones and project objectives.
  • Providing regular performance updates and variance analysis.
  • Representing the Planning function in client and subcontractor meetings.
  • Working closely with project teams and key stakeholders to ensure clear communication around programme status.
  • Supporting the development of long-term client relationships and contributing to wider business growth.
  • Taking ownership of assigned projects while supporting colleagues across the wider planning team.
  • Contributing to continuous improvement and the development of best-practice planning processes.
 
What We're Looking For
  • Degree qualified in Engineering, Construction Management or a related discipline.
  • A minimum of 2 years' experience within construction planning or project controls.
  • Experience working on large-scale construction projects, ideally within data centres, mission-critical or high-tech industrial environments.
  • Strong understanding of construction methodologies, sequencing and planning processes.
  • Proficiency in Primavera P6 and/or Asta Powerproject.
  • Experience with BIM or digital construction tools would be highly advantageous.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with an understanding of programming techniques and production rates.

job.title: Health & Safety Advisor
job.description:
Health & Safety Advisor

Location: National travel with regular visits to projects across the Southern Region and periodic travel to Manchester.

We're recruiting on behalf of a leading UK design and build contractor with over 30 years' experience delivering high-quality workplaces and commercial projects across the UK. Due to continued growth, they're looking to appoint an experienced Health & Safety Advisor to support and drive their Health & Safety strategy across a national portfolio of projects.

This is a fantastic opportunity to join a respected and forward-thinking organisation where you'll have the opportunity to influence Health & Safety standards, work closely with senior stakeholders and project teams, and play a key role in embedding a proactive and positive safety culture across the business.

What's on offer
  • Competitive salary

  • Company pension scheme

  • Life assurance

  • Critical illness cover

  • Range of wellbeing services, including EAP, bereavement support and 24-hour GP service

  • Cycle to work scheme

  • Electric car leasing scheme

  • Generous holiday allowance, plus 2 additional volunteer days

The ideal candidate You'll be an experienced Health & Safety professional with a strong background in the construction sector, ideally within fit-out. You'll be confident working with project teams, subcontractors, clients and senior stakeholders, with the communication skills and resilience to influence positive change across the business.

You'll also have:

  • NEBOSH Certificate (essential)

  • Strong working knowledge of CDM Regulations and their practical application

  • Experience advising on safe access systems, including tube and fit and mobile tower scaffolding

  • Knowledge of asbestos management and lifting operations, including mobile crane planning

  • Up-to-date knowledge of Health & Safety legislation and industry best practice

  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to produce high-quality reports

  • Excellent planning and organisational skills, with the ability to manage competing priorities

  • A collaborative, relationship-led approach to driving behavioural and cultural change

  • Full UK Driving Licence and flexibility to travel nationally

The role The Health & Safety Advisor will play a key role in supporting the company's Health & Safety strategy and maintaining high standards across its national portfolio of projects. You'll carry out regular site audits, develop and review risk assessments, review Construction Phase Plans and compliance documentation, and advise project teams and subcontractors on RAMS and safe systems of work.

You'll also support the design team with CDM compliance and design risk management, provide Health & Safety advice to clients and pre-contract teams, assist with behavioural safety initiatives, investigate accidents and incidents, produce reports and statistics, and support ISO audits and liaison with enforcing authorities where required.

This is an excellent opportunity for an experienced Health & Safety professional looking to take on a varied and influential role within an established design and build business. With exposure to projects, clients, senior leadership and multiple areas of the Health & Safety function, you'll have the opportunity to make a genuine impact while continuing to develop your professional expertise.

job.title: Appointed Person / Temporary Works Coordinator
job.description:
Lifting Appointed Person / Temporary Works Coordinator Location: Finland
Project: 250MW Greenfield Data Centre
Role Type: Contractor-Side – Civils / CSA

We are looking for an experienced Lifting Appointed Person / Temporary Works Coordinator to join the CSA/Civils delivery team on a major 250MW greenfield data centre project in Finland.

The role will have responsibility for the safe planning and coordination of lifting operations, while also supporting the management and control of temporary works across the civils and CSA package.

This is a site-based role working closely with the CSA Project Manager, Site Managers, subcontractors, lifting teams, engineers and wider project team.

The Role You will be responsible for ensuring lifting operations are properly planned, risk assessed and executed safely, while coordinating temporary works activities in accordance with the project requirements and relevant standards.

The successful candidate will be comfortable working directly with civils subcontractors and site teams, reviewing documentation, coordinating activities and ensuring that lifting and temporary works are properly controlled before works commence.

Key Responsibilities Lifting – Appointed Person • Act as the Lifting Appointed Person for the project and take responsibility for the planning of lifting operations

• Develop and review lifting plans, lift studies and risk assessments for complex and routine lifting activities

• Determine suitable cranes, lifting equipment, accessories and configurations for planned operations

• Review ground conditions, crane positioning, access and working areas prior to lifting activities

• Coordinate with crane suppliers, lifting supervisors, banksmen/signallers and subcontractors

• Ensure lifting operations are planned in accordance with relevant legislation, project procedures and safe systems of work

• Review lifting equipment certification and ensure equipment is suitable for the planned operation

• Identify potential lifting risks and ensure appropriate control measures are implemented

• Coordinate lifting activities with other construction works to avoid clashes and unsafe interfaces

• Monitor lifting operations on site and provide technical support where required

Temporary Works Coordinator • Coordinate the planning, design, review and implementation of temporary works across the CSA/civils package

• Maintain oversight of the temporary works register and ensure temporary works are properly categorised, designed and approved

• Coordinate with temporary works designers, engineers, subcontractors and site management

• Review temporary works proposals, drawings, calculations and design information

• Ensure appropriate temporary works design checks are completed before construction

• Ensure temporary works are installed, inspected, maintained and removed in accordance with approved designs

• Support site teams with temporary works queries and technical issues

• Ensure temporary works interfaces are properly coordinated with permanent works and other construction activities

• Maintain appropriate records, inspections and approvals throughout the temporary works process

Project Coordination • Work closely with the CSA Project Manager, Site Managers, Engineers and subcontractors

• Attend construction planning and coordination meetings

• Review upcoming works and identify lifting and temporary works requirements in advance

• Ensure required documentation is in place before activities commence

• Coordinate with the wider project team to ensure lifting and temporary works activities do not impact the construction programme

• Promote a strong safety culture across all lifting and temporary works activities

• Provide practical, site-based support to the construction team

Requirements • Proven experience working as a Lifting Appointed Person on major construction projects

• Strong knowledge of lifting operations, crane planning and lifting equipment

• Previous experience coordinating temporary works on major construction projects

• Experience working within civils, CSA, industrial, infrastructure or data centre projects

• Strong understanding of lifting plans, risk assessments, method statements and temporary works documentation

• Experience coordinating subcontractors and site teams

• Ability to review technical documentation including drawings, calculations and lifting studies

• Strong understanding of construction health & safety requirements

• Comfortable working in a fast-paced, site-based environment

• Strong communication and coordination skills

Desirable Experience • Previous experience working on hyperscale data centre projects

• Experience across large-scale CSA/civils packages

• Experience managing lifting and temporary works activities on greenfield projects

• Experience working alongside major civils contractors and specialist subcontractors

• Relevant lifting/appointed person and temporary works qualifications

What We're Looking For We are looking for a practical, site-focused professional who can take ownership of lifting operations and temporary works coordination across a large-scale CSA package.

The ideal candidate will be confident dealing with subcontractors and site teams, technically competent, highly organised and able to identify potential issues before they become problems.

This is a hands-on position for someone who is comfortable being on site, reviewing documentation, coordinating teams and making sure lifting and temporary works are properly planned and controlled.

The role is based in Finland and will require regular site presence.

job.title: Senior Mechanical Project Engineer
job.description:
# Senior Mechanical Project Engineer

**Location:** Finland
**Project:** 250MW Greenfield Data Centre
**Role Type:** Client-Side

We are hiring a **Senior Mechanical Project Engineer** to join our team in Finland to support the delivery of a **250MW greenfield data centre**.

This is a **client-side role**. You will represent the owner and take responsibility for the mechanical scope from design development through construction, testing, commissioning, and handover.

## The Role

You will oversee the mechanical infrastructure for the project, ensuring it is designed, installed, tested, and commissioned in line with the project requirements, local regulations, and agreed programme.

You will work closely with design consultants, EPC contractors, specialist mechanical contractors, equipment vendors, and commissioning teams to make sure the mechanical systems are delivered safely, on time, and to the required standard.

## Key Responsibilities

• Manage the mechanical scope across all project phases
• Review and coordinate mechanical design documentation from consultants
• Oversee the installation and delivery of mechanical systems across the data centre
• Monitor installation of **HVAC, chilled water, cooling, ventilation, pumps, pipework and associated mechanical plant**
• Coordinate mechanical interfaces with electrical, CSA and commissioning teams
• Review equipment specifications, technical submissions, method statements and commissioning procedures
• Attend FATs and support SATs, testing and commissioning activities
• Monitor contractor progress and ensure works are delivered in line with the project programme
• Ensure compliance with Finnish regulations and international standards
• Track progress, manage risks, and resolve technical issues
• Coordinate with civil, electrical, controls and commissioning teams
• Support final testing, commissioning and handover to operations

## Requirements

• Strong experience delivering **mechanical systems on large-scale projects**
• Experience on **data centres, industrial plants, pharmaceutical facilities, power projects, or similar critical facilities**
• Solid understanding of **HVAC, cooling systems, chilled water, ventilation and mechanical services**
• Experience managing mechanical contractors, consultants and specialist vendors
• Ability to review technical designs, specifications and installation documentation
• Experience working in a client-side, EPC or main contractor environment
• Ability to manage interfaces between mechanical and other project disciplines
• Comfortable working on site and leading technical discussions
• Strong understanding of construction, testing and commissioning processes

## What We’re Looking For

We are looking for someone practical and technically strong, who understands how **large-scale mechanical and cooling systems are designed, installed and commissioned**, and who can take ownership of the mechanical package from the client side.

Experience delivering mechanical systems within a **hyperscale data centre environment** would be highly advantageous.

This role is based in **Finland** and will require regular site presence.

If you are interested in applying, please reach out to **Billy Steer**.

job.title: Business Support Administrator
job.description:
Business Support Administrator - Manchester (M1)

Company and Role Overview

V7 Recruitment is a Manchester-based recruitment agency specialising in Engineering and Technical industries across the UK and Europe.

We have grown quickly by challenging how recruitment has traditionally been done, and we need someone equally driven to help keep that growth moving.
This is not a background administrative role where every day looks the same.

As a Team Administrator, you will sit at the centre of a fast-moving recruitment business, coordinating international travel, managing assignment documentation, resolving candidate queries and ensuring the details behind every placement are handled properly.

You will work closely with our Senior Leadership Team, consultants, candidates and internal departments, often becoming the person people rely on when something needs organising, answering or fixing.

The role would suit someone who enjoys responsibility, communicates confidently and takes pride in staying one step ahead.

Key Responsibilities
  • Travel and Accommodation Coordination: Organise flights, accommodation and travel arrangements for candidates working across the UK and Europe, responding quickly when plans change.
  • Assignment Administration: Coordinate assignment schedules and documentation, ensuring candidates and internal teams have the correct information at the right time.
  • Contract Support: Assist with contracts and act as a point of contact for contract-related questions.
  • Payroll and Expense Queries: Support candidates with payroll and expense queries, working with the relevant internal teams to resolve issues accurately and efficiently.
  • Tracking and Reporting: Maintain expense trackers, assignment records and administrative systems, ensuring information remains accurate and up to date.
  • Candidate Support: Support candidates before and throughout their assignments, providing a reliable point of contact when they need guidance.
  • Inbound Call Handling: Handle incoming calls with confidence and professionalism, resolving queries where possible or directing them to the right person.
  • Senior Leadership Support: Provide responsive administrative support to the Senior Leadership Team and help ensure the wider business continues to run smoothly.
What We Are Looking For

We are looking for someone who does more than wait for the next task.
You will be proactive, organised and comfortable taking ownership in an environment where priorities can move quickly.

You will also have:
  • Previous experience in an administrative, operations or business support role.
  • Experience maintaining trackers, records and administrative systems.
  • A confident and professional telephone manner.
  • Strong organisational skills and close attention to detail.
  • Clear written and verbal communication skills.
  • The ability to prioritise competing tasks without losing sight of the detail.
  • Confidence dealing with candidates and responding to contract, payroll and expense queries.
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Office and other administrative software.
  • A practical, collaborative approach and the confidence to solve problems independently.
  • Experience within recruitment or another fast-paced, service-led business would be beneficial, but attitude, organisation and ownership are just as important.
Why Join V7?
  • You will be joining an ambitious business where good ideas are listened to, responsibility is encouraged and people are trusted to make an impact.
  • This is an opportunity to take ownership of a varied role, work closely with senior leaders and become a key part of how V7 operates as the business continues to grow.
Working Conditions
  • This position is based in our Manchester office.
  • Working hours are 08:30-17:30 Monday to Thursday and 08:30-16:00 on Friday, with the option to work from home on Wednesday.
How to Apply

Ready to take ownership of a role where your work genuinely keeps the business moving?

Please submit your CV to workforus@v7recruitment.com.

Location: Finland
Sector: Data Centres | Mission Critical Construction
Employment Type: Permanent

The Opportunity

An established Tier 1 contractor is continuing the expansion of its long-term data centre programme, with multiple live developments currently under construction across Finland. They are now seeking an experienced Electrical Lead to join one of these major projects.

This is a senior site leadership position operating on a rotational working model, responsible for the overall delivery of the electrical scope across a major mission-critical project. As part of the senior project leadership team, you will provide strategic and technical leadership throughout construction, overseeing planning, coordination, installation, quality, safety, commissioning and handover to ensure successful project delivery.

Acting as the senior electrical authority on the project, you will provide leadership across multiple electrical workstreams while working closely with the Project Director, wider project leadership team and specialist subcontractors to achieve programme objectives.

This opportunity offers genuine long-term career progression within an established Tier 1 contractor delivering major data centre projects across Europe.

Key Responsibilities
  • Lead the overall electrical delivery across a major project from construction through to commissioning and handover.
  • Provide leadership, direction and technical support to Electrical Package Managers, Engineers, Supervisors and specialist subcontractors throughout the project lifecycle.
  • Coordinate electrical design, procurement, construction and commissioning activities to ensure safe, efficient and successful project delivery.

Comfortable leading multidisciplinary delivery teams, you will possess the technical expertise, commercial awareness and leadership capability to successfully manage large-scale electrical delivery from installation through to commissioning.

Ideally, you will possess:

  • Strong contractor-side experience delivering major electrical installations within large-scale data centre environments.
  • Proven experience leading Electrical Package Managers, Engineers, Supervisors and specialist subcontractors across complex construction projects.

job.title: Graduate Electrical Engineer
job.description:
- Graduate Electrical Engineer
- Perfect for a graduate or junior engineer
- HUGE career development for a world leading engineering company
- £32k - £35k & bonus, 25 day holiday, strong pension,
 
So you’ve just graduated – congratulations! After 3 or 4 years of good academic work you’re itching to put in to the “real world”.
 
But what next? It can be pretty daunting going into your first job, that’s going to shape your career & life, so pretty important to get right…
 
So how does coming into a world leading engineering company sound? 1 where you will have seen their products already and have an incredible track record of developing potential in to the finest engineering talent?
 
On that basis, we are looking to bring in a sharp electrical grad who wants to learn, develop and use this as a stepping stone in wherever you want to go in the engineering world. A rare opportunity for a long term career.
 
It’s all about you:
We don’t want someone who can “do it all”, we will train you there. But we do want someone who has a very good electrical engineering foundation who wants evolve your academic knowledge into engineering knowledge in the real world.
 
So as long as you have the drive, personality and motivation to want to lean and carry on your journey, we would love to hear from you.
 
The role:
This role is almost a mix of Design Engineering and Project Engineering. We manufacture some of the highest level electrical equipment (that goes around the world) and when a client needs something bespoke, we take over and guide them.
 
That’s where you come in (after a lot of training of course).
 
So a role where you are working with the end clients, seeing what they need leading these projects through design before they are manufactured (which is done on site, so you see it all come to life).
 
What next?
Sound like an opportunity that appeals? Simply hit apply and let’s have a chat. Look forward to hearing your story.

job.description:
Associate MEP Cost Manager

Data Centres | Norway / Finland


The Opportunity

We are supporting a leading international consultancy in the appointment of an experienced Associate MEP Cost Manager to join a major data centre programme in the Nordics.

This is a senior client-facing cost leadership role focused on the delivery of large-scale mission critical projects, with responsibility across MEP cost management, commercial reporting, stakeholder engagement and team leadership. The successful candidate will play a key role in the delivery of complex, high-value data centre projects across Norway and Finland.

The position offers flexibility in location, with the option to be based in-country full-time or work on a rotational basis across the Nordics and home location.


Key Responsibilities
  • Lead the delivery of large or complex MEP cost management workstreams across major data centre projects
  • Act as a primary client contact for cost and commercial reporting, quality assurance and day-to-day commercial matters
  • Manage project cost reporting, commercial outputs and client deliverables to ensure a high standard of service
  • Support and oversee teams of cost and commercial professionals across multiple project packages or workstreams
  • Review team outputs before submission to clients and external stakeholders
  • Maintain a clear understanding of client objectives and ensure project delivery aligns with commercial and contractual requirements
  • Support compliance with agreed scope of service and project delivery parameters
  • Contribute to the development and continuous improvement of cost management systems, processes and reporting standards
  • Provide leadership, guidance and performance support to junior team members and developing consultants
  • Support innovation and best practice across project delivery within a fast-paced technical construction environment

  • Track record supporting the delivery of large-scale construction or mission critical projects, ideally within the data centre sector
  • Strong understanding of construction processes, cost management and commercial reporting across MEP packages
  • Experience leading smaller projects or workstreams and contributing to larger, more complex programmes
  • Confident client-facing communicator with the ability to build strong external relationships and manage stakeholder expectations
  • Experience supporting or managing teams within a project cost or commercial environment
  • Degree qualified in Quantity Surveying, Construction Management, Engineering or a related discipline

  • Flexible location model with either full in-country placement or rotational working

job.title: Planner
job.description:
V7 Recruitment are looking for a Planner to join a major Data Centre project in Fredericia, Denmark.

This is an excellent opportunity for an experienced Planner to play a key role on a large-scale mission-critical project. Working closely with project managers, engineers and commercial teams, you will be responsible for developing, managing and monitoring programmes across design, procurement, construction, commissioning and handover phases.

The successful candidate will provide accurate programme information, identify risks and opportunities, and support project teams in delivering projects safely, efficiently and in line with contractual and commercial requirements.

Key Responsibilities Programme Development & Control
  • Develop and maintain baseline contract programmes, ensuring robust logic links and clear critical path analysis.
  • Prepare construction target programmes that identify opportunities for improved efficiency and project delivery.
  • Develop procurement and tender event programmes, including design release schedules and subcontractor lead-in activities.
  • Maintain programme documentation within the Common Data Environment (CDE).
  • Produce 2D phasing plans and 4D construction models to demonstrate build sequences, logistics and delivery strategies.
  • Collaborate with project teams to develop construction methodologies and sequencing plans.
  • Support project preliminaries planning, including staffing, logistics and temporary works requirements.
  • Liaise with the supply chain to incorporate design deliverables, lead-in times, construction durations and resource requirements.
  • Identify programme risks and opportunities, implementing mitigation measures and time-risk allowances where appropriate.
Reporting, Progress & Programme Management
  • Develop and monitor tracking schedules to validate subcontractor performance against programme.
  • Produce as-built programmes and analyse deviations from baseline schedules.
  • Support change management processes by assessing programme impacts and supporting approval workflows.
  • Utilise 2D and 4D planning information to communicate project status and progress.
  • Produce validated productivity and output metrics to monitor live project performance and support future tender planning.
  • Conduct peer reviews to maintain programme quality, consistency and accuracy.
Leadership & Stakeholder Management
  • Report programme status, risks and progress to project leadership and key stakeholders.
  • Support and mentor Assistant and Graduate Planners.
  • Coordinate planning activities throughout pre-construction and project delivery phases.
  • Assist with programme entitlement assessments under contract forms such as NEC and JCT.
  • Lead weekly and monthly programme reporting activities.
  • Ensure quality and consistency across all planning documentation.
  • Benchmark project durations using subcontractor feedback, historical project data and industry best practice.
Qualifications & Experience Essential
  • Degree or Diploma in Construction Management, Civil Engineering, Project Management or a related discipline (or equivalent industry experience).
  • Certification or advanced training in planning software such as Asta Powerproject.
  • Previous experience in a Planner role on large-scale construction, infrastructure, mission-critical or data centre projects.
  • Strong understanding of project controls, scheduling methodologies and programme risk management.
Desirable
  • Membership (or working towards membership) of a professional body such as CIOB, ICE or APM.
  • Advanced Asta Powerproject training, including S-curve reporting, progress analysis and resource management.
  • Experience using Synchro, BIM technologies and collaborative data platforms.
  • Knowledge of NEC and JCT forms of contract.
  • Presentation, communication and leadership training.
  • Previous experience working on data centre or other mission-critical construction projects.

job.title: Senior Engineer
job.description:
V7 Recruitment are looking for a Senior Engineer to join a major Data Centre project in Denmark.

This is an excellent opportunity to join a high-profile mission-critical project, taking a leading role in the engineering function on site. The Senior Engineer will provide engineering leadership, coordinate setting out and site control activities, and work closely with project management, subcontractors and the wider delivery team to ensure quality, safety and programme objectives are achieved.

The successful candidate will act as the primary point of contact for QA procedures, record keeping and engineering standards while supporting temporary works coordination, lifting operations and technical problem-solving throughout the project lifecycle.

Key Responsibilities
  • Provide engineering leadership across all site activities, ensuring works are delivered safely, accurately and efficiently.
  • Lead dimensional control activities and manage the transition between global and local grid systems.
  • Oversee the management and maintenance of survey equipment by the engineering team.
  • Ensure completion of as-built surveys for key project elements and analyse tolerances across multiple interfaces.
  • Maintain accurate engineering records and daily site diaries.
  • Support and manage quality control processes across construction packages.
  • Prepare, review and implement Inspection & Test Plans (ITPs).
  • Demonstrate strong technical understanding of key packages including concrete, drainage, structural steelwork and masonry.
  • Monitor compliance with project specifications, particularly structural tolerances and quality requirements.
  • Manage Non-Conformance Reports (NCRs), ensuring timely close-out and minimising defects and remedial works.
  • Issue and manage Permits to Break Ground where required.
  • Review and prepare method statements and risk assessments.
  • Identify missing information and coordinate Requests for Information (RFIs) to ensure programme continuity.
  • Support temporary works coordination and lifting operations in accordance with project requirements.
  • Work collaboratively with project, design and subcontractor teams to maintain engineering standards and project delivery objectives.
Qualifications & Experience Essential
  • Degree in Civil Engineering or a related discipline.
  • Previous experience in a Senior Engineer position on large-scale construction, infrastructure or data centre projects.
  • Strong understanding of engineering setting out, site control and quality management systems.
  • Experience managing NCRs, RFIs, ITPs and engineering documentation.
  • Strong knowledge of health, safety and quality procedures on major construction projects.
Desirable
  • Temporary Works Coordinator Training.
  • Lifting Operations Awareness Training.
  • CPCS A61 Appointed Person Qualification.
  • Scaffold Inspection/Awareness Training.
  • Experience with planning and programming software.
  • Previous experience delivering mission-critical or data centre projects.
  • Knowledge of BIM, digital engineering and construction technologies.

As the senior on-site leader for CSA works, you will be responsible for project delivery, quality, safety, commercial performance and client satisfaction, ensuring all works are completed to the highest standards and in line with programme objectives.

Working closely with project teams, consultants, subcontractors and stakeholders, you will play a critical role in driving project success from pre-construction through to handover.

Key Responsibilities Project Delivery
  • Lead the planning, management and delivery of CSA packages in line with programme, budget and project specifications.
  • Coordinate multidisciplinary teams across engineering, commercial, design and construction functions.
  • Monitor project performance, identify risks and implement mitigation measures where required.
  • Ensure resources are effectively allocated to achieve project milestones and delivery targets.
  • Maintain accurate reporting on programme, costs, quality and key performance metrics.
  • Drive successful project execution while maintaining focus on safety, quality and client satisfaction.
Quality, Safety & Compliance
  • Promote and maintain the highest standards of health, safety and environmental performance.
  • Ensure all works comply with design requirements, project specifications and statutory regulations.
  • Implement and monitor project-specific quality plans, inspection regimes and method statements.
  • Support project audits, inspections and compliance reviews.
  • Drive a culture of continuous improvement across project teams and subcontractors.
Commercial & Contract Management
  • Manage project budgets, cost forecasts, variations and cash flow.
  • Work closely with commercial teams to ensure accurate reporting and effective contract administration.
  • Oversee procurement activities and monitor subcontractor performance.
  • Support tendering, bid reviews and pre-construction planning activities when required.
  • Identify opportunities to improve project efficiency, value and profitability.
Leadership & Stakeholder Management
  • Lead and mentor project teams, promoting accountability, collaboration and professional development.

job.title: Lead Planner
job.description:
V7 Recruitment are looking for a Planning Lead to join a major Data Centre project in Denmark.

This role will support project teams by developing, managing and monitoring programmes across design, procurement, construction, commissioning and handover stages. The successful candidate will play a key role in ensuring projects are delivered safely, efficiently and in accordance with contractual, commercial and compliance requirements.

Working closely with project managers, engineers and commercial teams, you will provide accurate programme information, identify risks and opportunities, and support decision-making through robust reporting and analysis.

Key Responsibilities Programme Development & Control
  • Lead the development of baseline contract programmes using Primavera P6, ensuring clear logic links and critical path analysis.
  • Prepare construction target programmes that identify opportunities for efficiency and improvement.
  • Develop tender event programmes for subcontractor procurement, including design release and lead-in activities.
  • Maintain and manage programme documentation within a Common Data Environment (CDE).
  • Create phasing plans to illustrate build sequences, logistics and project delivery strategies.
  • Collaborate with project teams to develop construction methodologies that demonstrate safe and effective sequencing.
  • Support the preparation of project preliminaries, including staffing plans, logistics and temporary works requirements.
  • Engage with the supply chain to incorporate design deliverables, lead-in times, construction durations and resource requirements.
  • Identify programme risks and opportunities, implementing mitigation strategies and appropriate time risk allowances.
Reporting, Progress & As-Built Information
  • Develop and monitor tracking schedules to validate subcontractor programmes.
  • Produce as-built programmes and report deviations from baseline schedules.
  • Provide programme impact assessments to support change requests and approvals.
  • Utilise 2D/3D/4D phasing information to demonstrate programme status and progress.
  • Produce validated output rates to measure project performance and support future tender planning.
  • Conduct peer reviews of programmes to maintain quality, accuracy and consistency.
Leadership & Stakeholder Management
  • Report programme status, progress and risks to project stakeholders and senior leadership teams.
  • Support and mentor Assistant and Graduate Planners.
  • Coordinate planning and programme management activities throughout pre-construction and delivery phases.
  • Assist with programme entitlement assessments under contract forms including FIDIC, NEC and JCT.
  • Lead weekly and monthly programme reporting.
  • Ensure quality and consistency across all planning documentation.
  • Benchmark programme durations using historical project data, subcontractor information and team consultation.
Qualifications & Experience Essential
  • Degree or Diploma in Construction Management, Civil Engineering, Project Management or a related discipline (or equivalent professional experience).
  • Advanced knowledge of planning software such as Primavera P6 and/or Asta Powerproject.
  • Proven experience delivering large-scale construction or mission-critical projects.
Desirable
  • Membership (or eligibility for membership) of a recognised professional body such as CIOB, ICE or APM.
  • Advanced Asta Powerproject training, including progress analysis, S-curve reporting and resource management.
  • Experience with Synchro, BIM methodologies and collaborative data platforms.
  • Knowledge of NEC, JCT and FIDIC forms of contract.
  • Leadership, presentation and stakeholder management training.

job.title: Contract & Cost Manager
job.description:
Cost & Contract Manager (CCM) – Data Centre Construction
Location: Site-Based
Sector: Mission-Critical / Data Centre Construction
Employment Type: Full-Time

V7 Recruitment is partnering with a leading organisation delivering large-scale mission-critical infrastructure projects to appoint an experienced Cost & Contract Manager (CCM) for a major data centre construction project.

This is a key site-based role responsible for leading and managing all cost, commercial, and contract management activities across the project lifecycle. The successful candidate will play a pivotal role in maintaining commercial control, managing change, supporting contract administration, and ensuring accurate financial reporting across complex workstreams.

The ideal candidate will bring strong experience in large-scale industrial, data centre, pharmaceutical, or commercial construction environments and be confident operating in high-pressure, fast-paced project settings.

Key Responsibilities

Contract Management
  • Report to the senior commercial leadership team and provide day-to-day commercial support on site.
  • Coordinate all upstream and downstream commercial activities across contractors and subcontractors.
  • Act as the commercial interface between stakeholders, ensuring clear communication and reporting lines.
  • Manage multiple subcontractor accounts across CSA and MEP packages.
  • Lead change management meetings to drive commercial alignment and timely agreement of variations.
  • Oversee planned and reactive commercial activities to ensure all quantity surveying and cost control deliverables are completed on schedule.
  • Manage external cost consultants and ensure deliverables align with project governance and reporting requirements.
  • Support sourcing and tendering strategies in collaboration with project stakeholders.
  • Attend regular contractor and stakeholder meetings, providing commercial insight and guidance.
  • Develop and implement commercial processes, controls, and procedures in line with contractual obligations.
  • Prepare and issue commercial correspondence.
  • Maintain and update live commercial registers and reporting documentation.
  • Provide recommendations for approval while maintaining governance controls.

Monthly Valuations / Invoicing
  • Manage monthly valuation and payment cycles in line with financial deadlines.
  • Undertake joint site walks with contractors and project teams to verify progress.
  • Apply commercial due diligence to support valuation assessments and payment recommendations.
  • Conclude subcontractor valuations and prepare payment recommendations.
  • Prepare applications for payment with supporting documentation.
  • Issue payment certificates where required.

Change Management & Cost Control
  • Identify potential variations and assess cost, risk, scope, and programme impacts.
  • Review contractor payment applications and verify claimed progress.
  • Interpret drawings to assess scope changes and support pricing of variations.
  • Maintain risk and opportunity registers with supporting cost narratives.
  • Lead change control processes to ensure efficient close-out of upstream and downstream variations.

General Responsibilities
  • Understand project buildability and programme sequencing, including alignment with P6 schedules.
  • Proactively identify risks, delays, and constraints affecting project delivery.
  • Review and interpret civil, structural, and architectural drawings and technical submissions.
  • Liaise with design consultants, cost managers, commissioning teams, and project leadership.
  • Use measurement software such as Bluebeam (or equivalent) to measure and mark up drawings.

Health, Safety & Environment
  • Promote and maintain strong HSE standards at all times.

Documentation & Reporting
  • Manage commercially sensitive information with strict confidentiality.
  • Maintain accurate commercial records, live registers, and financial reports.
  • Ensure documentation is stored in accordance with project document control systems, including platforms such as Microsoft SharePoint.

Required Qualifications & Experience

Essential
  • Quantity Surveyor with proven experience managing CSA and MEP subcontractor accounts on major construction projects.
  • Strong commercial and contractual awareness.
  • Thorough understanding of claims management and dispute mitigation.
  • Advanced Microsoft Excel skills, including rapid analysis and presentation of commercial data.
  • Strong understanding of tendering and contract formation processes.
  • End-to-end experience managing change control, valuations, and payment processes.
  • Strong cost control, forecasting, budgeting, and financial reporting capabilities.
  • Excellent attention to detail and reporting accuracy.
  • Ability to manage multiple workstreams and prioritise effectively.
  • Experience with estimating, measurement, and benchmarking.
  • Proven ability to work independently and provide solutions proactively.
  • Experience working on high-value CapEx projects.
  • Experience operating on both client-side and contractor-side environments.
  • Strong technical understanding of civil engineering, structural systems, building envelopes, finishes, and construction methodologies.
  • Ability to interpret architectural and structural drawings, including BIM models.
  • Excellent communication, leadership, and contractor management skills.
  • Strong understanding of sequencing, constructability, and site logistics.

Desirable
  • Experience within hyperscale or colocation data centre environments.
  • Proficiency in measurement software such as Bluebeam.
  • Familiarity with FIDIC contract forms.

Personal Attributes
  • Highly organised with exceptional attention to detail.
  • Strong decision-maker and problem solver.
  • Comfortable working in fast-paced, high-pressure environments.
  • Excellent stakeholder management and communication skills.
  • Collaborative, proactive, and delivery-focused.
  • Strong integrity and commitment to safety and quality.

This is an excellent opportunity to join a high-performing team delivering cutting-edge mission-critical infrastructure on a flagship project.

This is a key commercial leadership role responsible for overseeing the financial and contractual performance of a major construction project. The successful individual will play an important role in driving commercial outcomes, managing project risk, supporting operational teams and ensuring robust commercial governance throughout the project lifecycle.

The role would suit an experienced Commercial Manager, Senior Quantity Surveyor, Managing Quantity Surveyor or Senior Commercial professional with experience delivering large-scale construction projects.


Key Responsibilities

Commercial Management
  • Manage all commercial and contractual aspects of the project from commencement through to final account
  • Prepare and manage valuations, applications for payment and associated commercial reporting
  • Monitor project costs, forecasts and cash flow performance
  • Support procurement activities and subcontract package management
  • Review and administer contract obligations and commercial risk
  • Manage variations, compensation events, claims and contractual entitlements
  • Maintain accurate project records and supporting commercial documentation
  • Prepare and negotiate interim and final accounts
  • Support project delivery teams in achieving commercial objectives
  • Ensure contractual compliance across all project activities

  • Lead, mentor and support members of the commercial team
  • Promote best practice and consistency across commercial processes
  • Build and maintain strong working relationships with clients, consultants and supply chain partners
  • Collaborate closely with project and operational leadership teams
  • Contribute to the ongoing development of commercial systems and procedures

Requirements
  • 10+ years' experience within a commercial or quantity surveying function
  • Experience working for a main contractor or large construction organisation
  • Proven experience delivering major construction projects
  • Strong understanding of contract administration, procurement and commercial management
  • Experience managing project financial performance, forecasting and reporting
  • Excellent negotiation, communication and stakeholder management skills

  • Degree qualified in Quantity Surveying, Commercial Management or a related discipline

job.description:
MEP Cost Manager


The Opportunity

V7 Recruitment are partnering with a leading international consultancy to appoint an experienced MEP Cost Manager to support the delivery of major data centre programmes across the Nordics. This is an opportunity to join a growing team operating within one of the fastest-expanding sectors in construction, working on large-scale data centre developments for some of the world's most recognised technology and infrastructure clients. The position offers flexibility around location, with options for both in-country and rotational working arrangements depending on individual circumstances. Working within an established project team, you will play a key role in the commercial delivery of complex projects while supporting client relationships, project leadership and wider team development.

Working within an established project team, you will play a key role in the commercial delivery of complex projects while supporting client relationships, project leadership and wider team development.

The successful candidate will take ownership of key project deliverables while contributing to the leadership and successful execution of major programmes.

  • Leading complex project workstreams and supporting successful project delivery.

job.title: Commissioning Manager - M&E
job.description:
V7 Recruitment are working with a leading consultancy firm who are looking for a Commissioning Manager for their data centre projects in Finland. The role involves leading and managing the full commissioning lifecycle across multiple projects, from initial design through to final closeout. This role acts as the central coordination point between stakeholders, contractors, and consultants to ensure a structured, efficient, and high-quality commissioning process.
Working across projects of varying size and complexity, including large-scale technical builds, the position requires strong leadership, organisation, and technical oversight to drive successful project outcomes.

You can be based either 100% in country, or there will be significant international travel to Finland

In return they are offering: 
  • A competitive salary
  • Car Allowance
  • Healthcare
  • Life Assurance
  • Income Protection
  • 27 Days Holiday + Bank Holidays
  • Flights/accommodation/expenses
Key ResponsibilitiesProject & Stakeholder Management
  • Lead the end-to-end commissioning process across multiple concurrent projects
  • Coordinate and manage activities between stakeholders, general contractors, commissioning agents, and design consultants
  • Drive progress, accountability, and alignment across all parties to ensure timely and successful delivery
  • Chair commissioning meetings and provide leadership across project teams
Design Phase
  • Review designs at key stages to assess suitability for commissioning
  • Provide input during design reviews and technical discussions
  • Support the development and refinement of commissioning specifications
Procurement Phase
  • Review tender documentation and trade packages to ensure alignment with commissioning requirements
  • Assess contractor proposals and tender returns to confirm technical compliance and suitability
  • Provide input into contractor selection from a commissioning perspective
Delivery & Site Activities
  • Support and oversee quality-focused site activities, including inductions and audits
  • Participate in and lead key project meetings, including:
    • Daily startup and commissioning meetings
    • Weekly progress and quality meetings
    • MEP coordination and planning sessions
  • Monitor commissioning progress and proactively address risks or delays
Reporting & Continuous Improvement
  • Develop and maintain commissioning dashboards, tracking key metrics and performance indicators
  • Provide regular reporting on commissioning status and progress
  • Capture and share lessons learned across projects to support continuous improvement
Skills & Experience
  • Strong understanding of large-scale construction and technical project delivery
  • Experience managing multidisciplinary teams and technical stakeholders
  • Proven ability to coordinate complex processes across multiple projects
  • Background in data centre projects (new build or refurbishment) is highly advantageous

job.description:

You can be based either 100% in-country, or there will be significant international travel to Finland or Norway (11/3 Rotation)

Pre-construction
  • Working with the client and general contractor to create and establish the Master Project Schedule and Master Project Budget

job.title: ELV / Integration Manager
job.description:
Job Description: ELV Integration Manager – Data Centre Construction

The ELV Integration Manager is responsible for managing, overseeing and executing all Extra Low Voltage (ELV) integration related workstreams on a mission-critical data centre construction project. The ELV Integration Manager will be based on site and will report directly to the Project Lead and PMC Directors. The individual will represent the Client and act as the technical interface between ELV vendors, MEP contractors, commissioning teams and the wider project team.

The role requires the ELV Integration Manager to lead the coordination, integration, testing and handover of all ELV systems, ensuring systems communicate correctly and operate in accordance with client operational requirements.

Key Responsibilities

ELV Integration Management
• The ELV Integration Manager will report to the Project Lead and PMC Directors.
• The ELV Integration Manager will coordinate all ELV-related workstreams across the project lifecycle.
• The ELV Integration Manager will act as the technical go-between between the client and appointed contractors/vendors.
• The ELV Integration Manager will ensure all ELV systems are fully coordinated and integrated.

Technical Coordination
• Review ELV designs, technical submittals and system architecture.
• Coordinate design interfaces between ELV, CSA and MEP packages.
• Identify technical gaps, clashes and interface risks.
• Support technical reviews and design workshops.
ELV Systems Oversight

Manage integration of systems including but not limited to:
• BMS
• EPMS
• SCADA
• Fire Alarm
• Access Control
• CCTV
• Structured Cabling
• Security Systems
• DCIM
• Leak Detection and Monitoring Systems

Construction Support
• Undertake site walks with contractors and project teams.
• Monitor installation progress and installation quality.
• Ensure containment, cabling and field device installation align with approved design.
• Resolve technical issues affecting installation progress.

Integration, Testing & Commissioning
• Coordinate controls integration between all ELV and MEP systems.
• Validate communications architecture and network connectivity.
• Support FAT, SAT and integrated systems testing.
• Troubleshoot integration, software and communication issues.
• Ensure systems meet operational and resilience requirements.

Programme & Risk Management
• Understand the buildability of the project and relate activities to a P6 schedule.
• Identify risks relating to controls integration and system readiness.
• Record technical risks and mitigation plans.
• Escalate critical path issues affecting commissioning or handover.

Health, Safety & Environment (HSE)
• Promote HSE at all times.
• Ensure safe working practices for testing and live systems integration.

Documentation
• Maintain live registers for interfaces, testing and technical issues.
• Ensure commissioning records and test documentation are complete.
• Adhere to document management systems including SharePoint and project software.

Required Qualifications & Skills

Essential
• Proven experience delivering ELV systems on large-scale industrial, data centre or mission-critical projects.
• Strong technical knowledge of BMS, EPMS, SCADA and controls architecture.
• Experience with integrated systems testing and commissioning.
• Understanding of communication protocols including BACnet, Modbus, SNMP and OPC.
• Strong understanding of structured cabling and network infrastructure.
• Ability to interpret technical drawings, schematics and controls diagrams.
• Strong stakeholder management and communication skills.
• Ability to manage multiple workstreams and prioritise effectively.
• Can work independently and proactively solve problems.
• Working on Capex projects.
• Working client and contractor side.

Desirable
• Experience within hyperscale or colocation data centre construction.
• Experience with DCIM platforms and building analytics.
• Familiarity with redundancy and resilience standards for critical environments.

Key Personal Attributes
• Highly organised with strong attention to detail.
• Decisive problem-solver capable of managing in high-pressure environments.
• Effective communicator with strong stakeholder management skills.
• Proactive, collaborative, and committed to delivering best-in-class work.
• Strong integrity and commitment to safety.

job.title: OFCI / LLE Manager
job.description:
OFCI/LLE Manager: V7 Recruitment 

About the Company

The OFCI / LLE Manager is responsible for managing, overseeing and executing all Owner Furnished Contractor Installed (OFCI) and Long Lead Equipment (LLE) related workstreams on a mission-critical data centre construction project. The OFCI / LLE Manager will be based on site and will report directly to the Project Lead and PMC Directors. The individual will represent the Client and act as the key interface between the Client, OEMs, vendors, logistics providers and appointed contractors.

About the Role

The role requires the OFCI / LLE Manager to proactively manage equipment procurement interfaces, manufacturing status, logistics, site readiness, installation coordination and handover activities to ensure all critical equipment packages are delivered, installed and commissioned in line with project programme requirements.

Responsibilities

OFCI / LLE Management
  • The OFCI / LLE Manager will report to the Project Lead and PMC Directors.
  • The OFCI / LLE Manager will manage all OFCI and LLE packages from procurement through to handover.
  • The OFCI / LLE Manager will act as the key interface between the Client, contractors, OEMs and specialist vendors.
  • The OFCI / LLE Manager will maintain accurate reporting channels for all equipment-related activities.
  • The OFCI / LLE Manager will ensure all critical equipment packages align with programme milestones.

Procurement & Manufacturing Coordination
  • Monitor manufacturing status of all long lead equipment.
  • Review vendor production schedules and identify risks to delivery dates.
  • Coordinate with client procurement teams regarding purchase orders and supplier commitments.
  • Attend vendor progress meetings and factory reviews where required.
  • Ensure manufacturing delays are identified and escalated early.

Logistics & Delivery Management
  • Manage shipping, customs, freight forwarding and site delivery activities.
  • Coordinate logistics planning for oversized and critical equipment deliveries.
  • Ensure site storage, access routes and lifting strategies are planned before delivery.
  • Maintain delivery trackers and live equipment registers.
  • Coordinate with contractors to ensure installation readiness.

Site Coordination & Installation
  • Undertake site walks with contractors and wider project teams.
  • Verify areas are ready for delivery and installation of critical equipment.
  • Coordinate with CSA and MEP teams to resolve access or sequencing constraints.
  • Ensure equipment installation follows approved drawings and technical requirements.
  • Support resolution of site-related issues affecting equipment installation.

Risk & Programme Management
  • Understand the project build sequence and relate activities to the P6 schedule.
  • Identify delays, constraints and programme risks relating to equipment.
  • Record risks, mitigation plans and recovery strategies.
  • Escalate critical path concerns to project leadership.

Commissioning & Handover
  • Coordinate vendor attendance for commissioning activities.
  • Support FAT, SAT and integrated systems testing.
  • Ensure equipment documentation is complete including warranties and O&M manuals.
  • Support handover to commissioning and operations teams.

Health, Safety & Environment (HSE)
  • Promote HSE at all times.
  • Ensure delivery and lifting activities are executed safely.
  • Ensure contractors follow site safety protocols during installation.

Documentation
  • Maintain OFCI trackers, logistics registers and issue logs.
  • Ensure all relevant documentation is recorded and stored correctly.
  • Adhere to document management systems including SharePoint and project software.

Qualifications
